land.note_B: slope-arc-r1 B (slope-arc-20261116): band centre re-timed to the clean landings (33 clean of 78 current-geometry passes, 11-14 3cf4 .. 11-16 7af0). kappa_table = the clean passes' median command (pre-compensation steer, smoothed 0.15 m) expressed as the curvature this layer's formula needs (kappa = (pre - c_eff) * g(v)) and placed at x + v*lead_s, so with lead_s 0.25 the centre reproduces the clean command: ~1680-1720 from the first LAND8 frame to x 0.85 (s 0.6), down to ~1520 at x 1.3-1.5 (near-straight L2), back to ~1670 from x 2.1 (arc). Equivalent to the clean curvature profile (first bend from s +0.15, peak 47-50 deg/m at s 0.7-0.8, near-straight s 1.2-1.5, arc 28-34 deg/m from s 2.0) advanced by the measured 0.35-0.45 m command lead and scaled by the measured command/curvature ratio. x = lap_pos metres since the LAND8 crossing = (s_seam + 0.22) / 0.967. m_hi 90 -> 60 (upper = clean median + 60 ~ clean p75; it is what cuts the press-type catch-up at 1780 to ~1760-1780), m_lo 90 with the inside-yield. turn_ref = clean median heading turned since the seam (old table lagged it 12-18 deg -> head -50..-80 us on every arc2-era pass, PID cut by 140-200 us). k_head 4 -> 2 / head_lim 80 -> 40 (_bm_yaw0 offset ~20 deg in 7 of 17 arc2-era passes). x_bend 0.85 -> 0.3 (floor from the first LAND8 frame). x_end 2.0 -> 2.3.
